tracker_meta.internal_notes:
Target intake: Autumn 2027. The scholarship deadline is the same as the admission deadline (1 March), and the scholarship letter must be uploaded with the admission application.
Scholarship GPA bar (4.0 on BI's 5-point ECTS scale) is higher than the admission bar (3.50 / B).
Admitted BI-Luiss students can ONLY get this scholarship, not other BI MSc scholarships. Only for a first master's degree.
Recipients must act as 'BI Ambassadors'. Must keep 30 ECTS per semester and a cumulative B average to keep the award.
Year 1 funded by BI, year 2 by Luiss.
GMAT/GRE: one of the two is required (GMAT 600 / GMAT Focus 555 / GRE Quant 158), unless a waiver is granted.
'Statement of Purpose' maps to the one-page scholarship application letter. Recommendation letters not verified.
Opening date taken from a third-party listing (Mastersportal); confirm on bi.no. Application fee not found on official pages.
Sources checked 2026-10-01: scholarship page, programme page, admission requirements page, 2026-27 tuition fee page (all bi.no).

financial_coverage.estimated_out_of_pocket_expense: Tuition covered: Year 1 at BI (NOK 179,400 for non-EU/EEA citizens, NOK 138,000 for EU/EEA, 2026-27 rates) and Year 2 at Luiss (EUR 15,000). academic_requirements.minimum_gpa: 4.0 on BI's ECTS scale for the scholarship (admission minimum 3.50 / B); minimum C in Marketing, Statistics and Economics courses

tracker_meta.internal_notes:
Two steps. 1) Apply to up to four SI-eligible master's programmes on University Admissions. In the 2026 cycle that round ran 16 Oct 2025 to 15 Jan 2026. 2) Apply for the scholarship on the SI portal. In 2026 it was open 9 to 25 February (closes 14:59 CET).
The 2027 dates are projected from the 2026 cycle. Confirm them on si.se when the list of eligible programmes comes out (mid-November).
Needs work experience (3,000 hours for most countries, including Bangladesh) and leadership experience. Two reference letters, passport, CV, proof of work and leadership, and a motivation in the portal.
Not eligible if you already hold a Swedish degree or had an SI scholarship before.
Nationality list is the 2026 list. It can change for 2027.
si.se blocked automated fetching during research, so details come from university and scholarship-listing pages that quote it.

tracker_meta.internal_notes:
Full ride ONLY if you win the Erasmus Mundus (EMJM) scholarship. Under current Erasmus+ rules that is EUR 1,400 a month for up to 24 months, and scholarship holders cannot be charged tuition or other mandatory participation costs. Self-funded places are NOT full ride. Apply in the scholarship round, not the self-funded round. You can apply to at most three EMJMs in one year. 
Consortium: University of Gothenburg (lead, Sweden), UiT The Arctic University of Norway (Tromsø), University of Deusto (Spain), University of Roehampton (UK).
Deadline is unclear for 2027. UiT lists 1 December; one listing says January 2027 (TBC). The programme website still shows an old (2023/24) notice.
One listing says EMJM scholarships are not yet confirmed for the 2027 intake. Check before you invest time.
